assessment: Assess complete responses against the supplied evidence. Evaluate recommendations as well as findings; no keyword scoring.

33 rejects transferring D7 to Relay and recommends Vault, the actual store owner.

limits: Author-written fictional cases; no private project identifiers or text are included.
Mechanically valid counts do not establish valid reasoning or corrections.
Severity is recorded for diagnosis only, not calibrated by these cases.
Single paired responses are not an error-rate estimate.
